answer_1.quote: We validate our approach through experiments on mathematical problem-solving tasks, where deterministic evaluation allows for precise accuracy measurements, as well as on more diverse and subjective chat-based tasks.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include solutions to math problems and responses in chat-based conversations.

answer_2.quote: We evaluated our model's performance based on the accuracy of the gsm8k dataset. We measured its answer accuracy using our custom implementation for inference and answer extraction.

answer_3.quote: We adopt OpenAI's GPT-4-1106-preview model as both the annotator and the evaluation baseline.
